name: Boot Barn
outlook:
What Boot Barn says to expect

  • Third fiscal quarter 2027: total salesFor the third fiscal quarter ending December 26, 2026, the Company expects: ​ ● Total sales of $785 million to $802 million, representing growth of 11% to 14% over the prior-year period.
  • Fiscal year 2027: total salesFor the fiscal year ending March 27, 2027, the Company now expects: ● To open 75-80 stores. ● Total sales of $2.565 billion to $2.593 billion, representing growth of 14% to 15% over Fiscal 2026.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
